take: OTT announced that left winger Andre Burakovsky was placed on injured reserve. He had played 8 games this season with no goals or assists, averaging 11 minutes a night, and his own expected goals (a measure of shot quality) were 0.59, so he was slightly behind that mark. Ottawa generated 46% of the 5-on-5 expected goals with him on the ice, about six points of team share better when he sits. We have no projection for who takes his minutes, but the 9-5-1 Senators lose a depth forward, not a driver.
